name: 16648 · Hollidaysburg, PA
findings: ZIP 16648 (Hollidaysburg) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16648 (Hollidaysburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16648 (Hollidaysburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
